description: Creates or retrieves a PDF certificate for a specific notification receiver. Requires notification_request_send and notification_receiver_add. Generate a UUID v4 for `id` the first time and reuse that id when polling. This tool is idempotent: it first lists existing certificates for the receiver and, if `id` already exists, returns it instead of creating it again. If the certificate status is CERTIFIED, the response includes documentUrl when available. If it is CERTIFYING, poll this same tool with the same id.
name: notification_certificate_get
